bio: Enjoy Afternoon Tea in London's most secretive garden. Tucked away in the back streets of Kensington are five stunning pop-up domes laid out. Each dome is fully air-conditioned and exclusive to you, so rest assured only you and your friends will have complete privacy in your dome.  Enjoy an Afternoon Tea served with freshly prepared classical sandwiches. As tradition suggests you cannot have an afternoon tea without English scones. Served as warm vanilla scented both plain and raisin scones along with traditional Devonshire clotted cream and tip tree strawberry jam as well as a generous selection of desserts. Each sitting is for one and a half hour period. You are welcome to continue your afternoon in the Garden or Kens Bar.  Located in the borough of Kensington and Chelsea, close to the museum district, Hyde Park and Harrods, London Secret Garden Kensington is the perfect setting for Afternoon Tea with your friends, family or colleagues.
